sources.title: Botswana travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Estonia
sources.officialityEvidence: Estonia MFA's live Reisi Targalt country guidance, updated 10 April 2026, expressly gives Estonian citizens Botswana's visa-free duration.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Välisministeeriumi andmetel võivad Eesti kodanikud viibida Botswanas viisavabalt kuni 90 päeva.

policies.title: Estonian ordinary passports: Botswana visa-free short visit
policies.summary: Estonia's current MFA guidance explicitly permits Estonian citizens to visit Botswana visa-free for up to 90 days.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Estonian-passport stays of up to 90 days.
Work, residence, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain outside this policy.
